'''Arbiters''' were the equivalent of [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyers]] in the [[Ahto City Civil Authority]]. An arbiter was expected to be impartial and a neutral observer; however, not only [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] served in the position. [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] officers could be arbiters during the [[Jedi Civil War]], even in cases involving the other party. [[Bwa'lass]] and [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] both held the position, as well.
